verified_facts.text: The hotel has a bridge that connects directly to Taipei 101.
verified_facts.excerpt: the only 5-star hotel in Taipei with a bridge that directly connects to Taipei 101

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites offer views of Taipei 101, Taiwan's tallest skyscraper, which is next door, as well as other city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooms and suites offer stunning views of Taipei 101, which is Taiwan’s tallest skyscraper and next door, as well as other city views

verified_facts.text: Major public transportation is a five-minute walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: take a five-minute stroll to major public transportation

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms are designed with a residential touch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed with a residential touch, each room provides a personal sanctuary, perfect for both relaxation and business needs.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Executive 101 View Suite has a Taipei 101 view, a living room and a bedroom, a marble bathroom with a bathtub, and Grand Club Lounge access.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the Taipei 101 view from the 893 sq ft (83 sq m) home with a living room and a bedroom, a marble bathroom with a bathtub, and access to the Grand Club Lounge.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite is an apartment-style suite with a 24-hour private butler and Grand Club Lounge access.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the exclusive privileges including a 24-hour private butler and access to the Grand Club Lounge by staying in the 2,379 sq ft (221 sq m) apartment-style suite.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club Lounge on the 22nd floor has panoramic Taipei skyline views and offers continental breakfast, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 22nd floor of the hotel, the Grand Club Lounge offers panoramic views of the Taipei skyline, an intimate atmosphere along with a continental breakfast, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail experience.

verified_facts.text: The temperature-controlled outdoor pool on level 5 is set in lush landscaping with sun beds, lounge areas and a pool bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: temperature-controlled outdoor swimming pool on level 5, with its lush landscape, stylish yet comfortable sun beds, lounge areas and a pool bar

verified_facts.text: Club Oasis has a 24-hour fitness center and an exercise studio with classes such as yoga and aerobics.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club Oasis features a 24-hour fitness center with modern equipment and an exercise studio offering classes such as yoga and aerobics.

verified_facts.text: Club Oasis has separate men's and women's wet areas with a sauna, steam room and whirlpools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can relax in separate men’s and women’s wet areas, including a sauna, steam room, and whirlpools with micro bubble and jet systems.

verified_facts.text: Pearl Liang serves Cantonese cuisine, seafood and dim sum in a 'private residence' setting by designer Tony Chi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in Tony Chi's "private residence" dining setting, known internationally for its design expertise.

verified_facts.text: A team of 30 chefs cooks Asian specialties in a show kitchen at Café.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, with a pet-friendly package of rooms, amenities and services designed for dogs.
verified_facts.excerpt: pet-friendly package featuring rooms and suites with amenities and services designed for your beloved dog companion

verified_facts.text: The hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities.
